alert.p: At a glance. Over-allocated icon atlases, unpruned postings, and unchecked index headers broke memory budgets and risked crashes. Lazy 512x512 GPU atlases, cost-based hybrid joins, and cancelable bounds-checked walkers cut latency up to 15.1x. Exact brute-force search parity, the .zidx disk format, and all 13 UI state machines remain unchanged.

doc.p: Companion artifacts include Zigder Codebase Overview and Zigder Architecture Whiteboard.

Commit 363428d0 defaulted Images.side to 2048 (16 MB) and left Tester.text.images.sink unset. Rendering two 32x32 file icons allocated a 16 MB CPU buffer plus a 16 MB Metal texture. Starting the atlas at 512x512 (1 MB) with direct GPU Sink uploads in src/ui/gpu_rest.zig removed that waste. Trimming idle BGRA caches, freeing inactive ColumnPanes, and capping NFA worker shards passed all nine budgets.
Every search fast path preserves exact Query.matchPath scores and passes bruteForceSearch oracle checks in Debug and ReleaseFast.

step.title: Tight per-name upper bound in the trigram tier
step.p: TopK.push activates floor_score at k items instead of 2 * k. tryTrigramTier drops the +100 head bonus when ni.head != tok.text[0], cutting con to 145.3 µs.

step.title: Direct zone scan for small folder scopes
step.p: Scopes up to 16,384 entries run searchSmallScopeSingle directly instead of waking six worker threads across 714k names. Query in:~/devv/zigder e drops from 6398.3 µs to 806.4 µs.

step.title: Cost-based hybrid multi-token join & 16B/32B NEON SIMD
step.p: buildDirMemo scopes propagation, reuses Searcher.Scratch buffers, and picks the smaller side via sum-over-supersets DP. Paired 16-byte and 32-byte NEON masks in src/search/fuzzy_simd.zig accelerate short filename scans.

doc.p: Each hazard reproduced first as a red test in src/tests/engine.zig or src/tests/fileops.zig before its fix landed.

td.p: @intCast panicked with SIGABRT in Debug, while inverted name_off tables crashed uname().
Checked mulIndex and addIndex math, range-checked headers, and validated monotonic offset tables in src/index/read.zig.
H1 / E2 / E3 walker cancel & fd leaks
Engine.stop() blocked 5.5 s on /System/Library and leaked DirFd handles under pushWork OOM.
Wired walk.scanCancel to Engine.stopping, drained queued items via freeWorkItem, and skipped canceled index writes.
EACCES on a 0555 parent ran copyToExactPath plus deleteImmediately, deleting readable children in the source folder.
Rejected subtree self-moves, handled APFS case-only renames on EEXIST, and restricted copy-plus-delete strictly to EXDEV.
Empty names created sub/ 2, ../escaped escaped the parent directory, and NUL bytes truncated C paths.
isValidEntryName blocks empty, dot, slash, and NUL names in src/fs/ops.zig. src/measure.zig packs Mach timebase atomically.

ul.li: Extracted TCC path policy into src/index/tcc.zig so all 57 Zig files stay under 600 lines.
Deduplicated writeFd, ensureParentDir, trimTrailingSlash, and freePaths across accel.zig, read.zig, cli.zig, bench.zig, and ops.zig.
Replaced system("rm -rf ...") shell calls in src/bench.zig and removed six asConstSlices heap copies in src/app/.
